The '''Abhean system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Maldrood sector/Legends|Maldrood sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abhean/Legends|Abhean]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this system was located in space contested over by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. It eventually fell into CIS hands.
